messages:
alex-m: CI perf alert popped up for the pre-dawn run — p50 latency +5% on small-batch bench vs baseline. link: https://redwood.ci/reports/1830003210 :eyes:
ci-bot: automated alert: perf/regression detected (small-batch). suite: runtime-small-batch, sample: nightly-2026-03-17, diffs: p50 +5%, p95 +1% — job: https://redwood.ci/job/infra/nightly/1830003210
maya: ouch. any obvious infra flakiness?
samir: not seeing infra alarms in metrics. the allocator graphs look ok. posting quick flame later if needed.
jordan: I can run a focused perf profile with --perf-sample and the exact bench config. want heap + kernel traces?
alex-m: @jordan pls run perf sampling and KV cache disabled hit to rule out cache effect. @samir can you start a bisect run across the last 30 commits? i'll hand off ownership so we don't step on each other. :pray:
samir: taking bisect. will kick off `tools/ci/bisect.sh --suite=runtime-small-batch --range=HEAD~30..HEAD` and report back with the first bad commit.
jordan: running profile now. command I used:
```
./tools/bench/run.sh --suite=runtime-small-batch --repeat=20 --flags="--kv-cache=0 --batch-mode=continuous --perf-sample=1"
```
will upload perf.zip to the job artifact when done.
devon: I'll check infra overlays — CUDA driver versions and GPU churn around the run window. also checking redis/cache miss rates.
maya: also want to know if any recent scheduling/kernel changes landed on runtime. @alex-m any PRs to call out?
alex-m: looks like 2 PRs merged yesterday: 1) batching refactor (samir) 2) small kernel tweak (pr #4123 by @lee). assigning triage owners: bisect -> @samir, profiling -> @jordan, infra checks -> @devon, review PRs -> @maya (can you eyeball kernel tweak?), i'll coordinate rollbacks if needed.
samir: bisect job started, ETA ~25m. I'll post first bad-commit hash here.
jordan: profile finished, uploaded artifact: https://redwood.ci/artifacts/1830003210/perf.zip — early look shows a small contention in the batching loop at 2-3ms per token. attaching flame snippet:
```
flamegraph.html -> top sample: runtime::batching::dispatch
```
may be related to the refactor.
devon: infra is clean. no driver upgrades, no host OOMs. redis miss rate unchanged.
maya: glanced at kernel tweak PR; it touches attention kernel padding logic but looks unrelated. leaving deeper review to @lee but low likelihood.
samir: bisect found first bad commit: f4a9c2d — batching refactor change that adjusted prefetch window. rolling a canary to confirm.
alex-m: good catch. @samir can you revert locally and run the nightly bench to confirm delta? @jordan once you confirm profile aligns with batching hotspot we'll prepare rollback.
samir: revert done locally, rerunning bench now. preliminary p50 back to baseline (-0.2% delta). confirming with full pass.
jordan: profiling with revert shows dispatch contention gone in flamegraph. looks like prefetch window change increased mutex waits under our small-batch distribution.
devon: infra checks complete, nothing else to blame.
alex-m: plan: roll back batching refactor in next canary and monitor. will open a follow-up PR with adjusted prefetch heuristic and tests. thanks all for quick turnaround :thumbsup:
maya: nice teamwork. please add an automated regression test for small-batch latency distribution so this flags earlier.
alex-m: will do. copying notes into incident doc: https://redwood.docs/incidents/1830003210-triage
samir: posting bisect log: https://redwood.ci/logs/bisect/1830003210.txt
jordan: artifact link again: https://redwood.ci/artifacts/1830003210/perf.zip
ci-bot: alert resolved by user action: rollback candidate deployed to canary.
alex-m: closing this thread — follow-ups tracked in the incident doc. thanks :rocket:
